Tassel does not require an account, does not ask you to sign in, and does not collect or sell personal information. Everything you create in the app is stored on your device.

When you play a song preview or view album artwork, the app requests that audio and image from Apple’s public iTunes preview service. Apple receives the request as part of serving it — that means your device’s IP address and which track was asked for. Nothing you have written or saved is included.

These requests carry no account and nothing you have written. We do not receive them — they go directly from your device to the service named.

Some screens can open www.amazon.com in your browser when you tap them. The app does not contact those sites by itself and sends them nothing; tapping hands the address to your browser, and the browser goes there.

There is no advertising, no tracking, and no third-party analytics in the app. Nothing you do in it is profiled or sold.

Deleting the app removes everything it kept on your device. Questions about privacy? Email jonathanbbiles@gmail.com.
